`entities/`: HTTP clients/service accessors; `models/`: public API request/response types; `pkg/`: SDK utilities; `examples/`: runnable examples (start `examples/mass-demo-generator`); `docs/`: generated docs/guides; `scripts/`: automation. Root: `Makefile`, `go.mod`, `.env.example`, `PLAN.md`.

Commands: `make set-env` creates `.env` from `.env.example`; `make test` / `make test-fast`; `make coverage` writes HTML report to `artifacts/`; `make lint` / `make fmt` / `make tidy`; `make verify-sdk`; `go build ./...`; `go test -v ./path/to/file_test.go`; `go test -v ./path/to/package -run TestName`; `make docs`; `make godoc` (http://localhost:6060). Demos (interactive off): `make demo-data` or `cd examples/mass-demo-generator && DEMO_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 go run main.go --org-locale=br --patterns=false`.

Go 1.24.x. Run `make fmt` before committing. Follow standard Go style and [Go Code Review Comments](https://github.com/golang/go/wiki/CodeReviewComments). Package names lowercase, single-word; exported names CamelCase, unexported names camelCase. Imports: standard, external, internal. Keep functions small and context-aware (`context.Context` first); return rich errors. Use functional options for configuration and interfaces for external dependencies (especially lib-commons). Document exported functions, types, variables. Lint with `golangci-lint` (`make lint`). No panics in library code. Use Go `testing` with `testify` and `gomock` where useful. Tests: `*_test.go`, `TestXxx`, table-driven where appropriate. Write unit tests for all new code (minimum 80% coverage). Run `make test` locally; target >80% coverage for new critical logic; generate report with `make coverage`.

Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <description>`; types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `chore`, `refactor`, `test`. PRs include purpose, scope, key changes, how-to-test, linked issues. Run `make fmt lint test verify-sdk` before opening a PR; include demo commands when applicable.

Never commit secrets. Configure via `.env` (copy from `.env.example`). Typical vars: auth token and onboarding/transaction API URLs. Ensure idempotent requests by setting `X-Idempotency` header via context when needed. Keep changes minimal and scoped; update `PLAN.md` when finishing milestones or adding flags/patterns. Touch only relevant packages; follow existing folder conventions. After generator or example changes, verify with `make demo-data` and document new flags in `docs/`.
